```sql
WITH combined AS (
  SELECT "Centre" AS centre, "Month" AS month, "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled, "Avg Daily Present" AS present
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "centre_name" AS centre, "month" AS month, "enrolment" AS enrolled, "average_attendance" AS present
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
monthly_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    centre,
    month,
    year,
    CASE 
      WHEN enrolled IS NULL OR enrolled = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (present * 100.0) / enrolled
    END AS rate
  FROM (
    SELECT centre, month, enrolled, present, 2023 AS year FROM "attendance_2023"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT centre, month, enrolled, present, 2024 AS year FROM "attendance_2024"
  ) sub
),
avg_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    centre,
    AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023,
    AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024
  FROM monthly_rates
  GROUP BY centre
),
drops AS (
  SELECT 
    centre,
    (avg_2023 - avg_2024) AS drop
  FROM avg_rates
  WHERE avg_2023 IS NOT NULL AND avg_2024 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT centre
FROM drops
WHERE drop > 0
ORDER BY drop DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
